picks.title: 牢笼鬼魂

picks.summaryEn: In a notorious prison, an invisible force begins killing inmates brutally, compelling enemy gangs and corrupt guards to work together as they try to survive the mounting bloodshed.

picks.title: 逃出布迪秀
picks.summary: 一行人意外坠入诡异老式儿童节目次元。画风酷似玛卡巴卡，软萌橙色独角兽巴迪主持欢乐秀场。一旦拒绝配合演出，便会惨遭猎杀，死者还会被节目直接替换。众人被困虚假片场，一边躲避玩偶的疯狂追杀，一边拼死寻找逃出电视空间的出路。
picks.summaryEn: A magical, singing orange unicorn holds his cast hostage in a surreal TV-show dimension, as he becomes more and more demented.

picks.title: 死亡幻觉
picks.summary: 一名问题少年在诡异地逃过一场离奇事故后，不断被一个穿着巨型兔子装的神秘男子幻象纠缠，并被操纵犯下一连串罪行。
picks.summaryEn: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a large bunny rabbit that manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.
